2030 Goal: Community Impact
Description. Deliver 10 million volunteer hours to 
improve our local communities, including an increase 
in skills-based volunteerism.
Baseline. Progress measured from baseline of  
Jan. 1, 2020.
Progress in 2020. During 2020, our employees 
volunteered 910,000 hours in our local communities, 
including many COVID-19 projects that leveraged 
employees’ technology skills and expertise.  
Looking Ahead. In 2021, our target is to reach  
1 million volunteer hours, and to continue to  
expand out skills-based volunteering activities.
